Cartilaginous_Dorsal_Fins.description: The Cartilaginous Dorsal Fins are razor-sharp appendages that extend from a creature's back, slicing through water with the grace of a shark. They grant unmatched speed and predatory instincts, allowing the user to breach the surface in a fearsome display of power.

Horizontal_Tail_Fluke.description: The Horizontal Tail Fluke slices through the water with a sinuous grace, propelling its massive form forward with an effortless yet powerful breach that commands respect from all who witness it.

Continuous_Ribbon_Fin.description: The Continuous Ribbon Fin undulates with a mesmerizing eel-like grace, enhancing speed and stealth as it glides through aquatic environments with fluid, almost hypnotic motion.
